rk_sdk.changes: Added support for the latest rk_factions update, improved framework compatibility, and included various stability improvements and bug fixes.
rk_sdk.update: Replace the existing rk_sdk resource with this version before updating rk_factions.

rk_factions.changes: Refined and polished the faction UI, added the new Faction Freeze system for temporarily locking faction activity, introduced customizable Faction Mystery Boxes with a CS:GO-inspired opening UI, and included various performance improvements and bug fixes.
rk_factions.update: Replace the existing resource with the latest version and ensure rk_sdk v1.0.1 or newer is installed before starting rk_factions.

rk_stashes.changes: Initial release of rk_stashes. Adds faction stash functionality with ownership management, access control, and faction integration.
rk_stashes.update: Install this resource alongside rk_factions. This resource is included with rk_factions and is not currently available separately.
